objective: Reduce avoidable feedback latency for routine Ron System engineering by separating isolated PWA verification from backend/PostgreSQL/Docker and global continuity gates, while preserving every gate on the files that can materially affect it. This manifest is an explicit process-repair closeout after the post-main architecture guard correctly caught that the regression-enforcement routing change had been promoted without a same-range Architecture Mode manifest.

roles_before.artifact: system-cloud-ci runs model tests, a real PostgreSQL action-gate/HTTP integration check and an independent production-Docker smoke for System cloud changes.
continuity-guard protects architecture manifests, current owners/routing, continuity coverage, controller routing, capital-system routing and XMind regressions.
Before this change isolated PWA/public edits were validated indirectly by the much broader System cloud and continuity workflows rather than by a dedicated focused gate.
The retired LifeUp rollback workflow remains independently scoped to legacy/routing surfaces and must not become a routine dependency of cloud-only or PWA-only edits.
Base SHA efd61f997d1066ec7546299d3d768f8ff6500156 preserves the pre-PWA-fast-gate workflow routing and remains available in Git history.

role_dispositions.destination: Backend/runtime/schema/Docker/package and non-PWA cloud tests still trigger the full model + PostgreSQL + Docker system-cloud-ci; only isolated public/PWA contract paths are excluded.

Architecture/owner/routing/continuity changes still trigger the full continuity workflow; only isolated PWA/public paths with no authority, owner, routing or continuity semantics are excluded and receive their own focused gate.
A dedicated system-pwa-ci validates PWA JavaScript syntax, focused PWA/projection contracts and a served-shell/health smoke, with stale-run cancellation and a five-minute job bound.
The previously narrowed legacy LifeUp workflow remains unchanged by this slice and still runs on the legacy/routing paths that can affect its rollback contract.
Git base SHA efd61f997d1066ec7546299d3d768f8ff6500156 provides exact rollback/provenance for the former workflow routing.

capability_probes.assertion: A backend/runtime/schema/package change still routes to system-cloud-ci and exercises the real PostgreSQL gate plus production Docker smoke.
An isolated PWA/workflow-only edit routes to system-pwa-ci without requiring the backend PostgreSQL/Docker gate or unrelated global continuity regression suite.
Changes to architecture-sensitive routing/owner/skill/continuity surfaces continue to invoke continuity-guard and cannot bypass the Architecture Mode manifest gate.
Base SHA efd61f997d1066ec7546299d3d768f8ff6500156 reconstructs the previous CI routing exactly.

tests.expected: PASS in the focused PWA workflow; the isolated routing-proof commit launches only system-pwa-ci.

tests.expected: Model, PostgreSQL, Docker and continuity checks all PASS before final routing proof.
